text:
Previously the patient had 9 seizures per week.
Currently there are 2 cluster days per month with typically 6 seizures within 24 hours.
Between cluster days the patient is seizure-free.
Contact the clinic if cluster days exceed 3 per month.
Medication is 500 mg twice daily.

Previously seizures occurred 8 times per day.
Currently the patient has 3 seizures per week.
Increase medication to 200 mg if seizures exceed 5 per day.

Since the last review the patient has had 3 isolated seizures over 2 months.
Medication remains 100 mg daily.

The patient has had no epileptic seizures for 6 months.
Their sister had 2 seizures last year.

Seizures occurred 4 times per week in childhood.
Current seizure frequency was not discussed.
Contact the clinic if seizures exceed 2 per day.

Currently the patient has frequent seizures.
Medication is 100 mg daily.
